rationale: The robot's performance indicated issues with line tracking stability, evidenced by 2 line loss events and a maximum error of 0.060533. To address this, I increased the kp value from 0.8 to 0.9 to enhance responsiveness. I also reduced the side sensor weights to 0.7 to prioritize the center sensor, which should improve tracking stability. Additionally, I increased the base speed to 0.15 to enhance overall progress without compromising control. These changes are expected to reduce line loss events and improve the maximum error.
